## 附录

### 附录A：恶意VBS检测YARA规则

```
rule qbot\_vbs
{
meta:
description = "Catches QBot VBS files"
author = "Alex Ilgayev"
date = "2020-06-07"
strings:
$s3 = "ms.Send"
$s4 = "for i=1 to 6"
$s5 = "if ms.readyState = 4 Then"
$s6 = "if len(ms.responseBody) <> 0 then"
$s7 = /if left\(ms.responseText, \w\*?\) = \"MZ\" then/
condition:
filesize > 20MB and $s3 and $s4 and $s5 and $s6 and $s7
}
```
